hero.intro: Bangalore-based documentary filmmaker with 12 years of directing, writing, and teaching across India.

about.lead: Anoushka Mathews is a Bangalore-based filmmaker, writer, and cyanotype artist who has grown up across the country.
paragraphs: Over the past 12 years, she has directed and edited both short and feature-length documentaries, and non-fiction films for multiple organisations and institutions.
She has also written for multiple print and online publications, and has taught, mentored, and facilitated workshops for diverse audiences.

education.institution: Films and Television Institute of India, Pune

education.degree: P.G Diploma in TV and Video Production

education.institution: Jesus and Mary College, Delhi University
